rows.item: Secondary sources disagree on whether online sports betting is authorised in Mexico. Some say it is legal under a SEGOB permit holder; others say online operation needs a separate DGJS authorisation; one says online gambling is 'legal' with ~30 licensed operators (S14). The official 1947 law text reviewed (S05) contains no online provision in the articles read.
rows.why: No official SEGOB statement was retrieved. No operator counts or tax rates were used.

rows.item: The Cámara ficha lists 'Sin reforma' (no amending decrees). Secondary sources cite a regulation reform of 16 Nov 2023 and a law reform announced in Sep 2026.
rows.why: Could not confirm either reform from an official source. Not used.

rows.area: Injury data scope rule (tool vs data vs requirements)
rows.item: tools/fetch_injuries.py documents a keep-only-Out/Doubtful rule, but data/injuries_w10_2026.json holds 160 rows that include 84 Questionable rows (66 Out, 10 Doubtful). REQUIREMENTS.md R-15 still says 75 Out/Doubtful rows.
rows.why: The three documents describe three different populations. Questionable players are published on the official page (e.g. Malik Harrison, NYG, Questionable; Brenden Schooler, NE, Questionable) and are present in the data, so the parser's documented rule and the CI fixture expectation no longer describe the dataset. Any count on the site must name which population it counts.
rows.status: Unverified as a rule decision; data matches the live page on 23 sampled rows (checked 2026-11-16). Reviewer to choose the population and align tools/fetch_injuries.py, the CI fixture and R-15.. Update 2026-11-16: the population question stands; the 160 rows cited here are now 171 (see F-24).

rows.area: Week 10 injury counts and no-injury sections (user brief)
rows.item: The brief states the live report has 279 rows and 2 no-injury sections, versus 254 rows and 4 sections on the site, and that Seattle and Cincinnati list 15 and 4 players while shown as injury-free. This session could not reproduce these counts: the local file holds 160 rows, with SEA 4 and CIN 4 rows. Live chunks 0–1 of 8 were read; the Seattle and Cincinnati sections are not in those chunks.
rows.why: A full eight-chunk capture, reconciled row by row, is needed before any count is republished. Not completed in this session. The 23 sampled rows that were checked match the live page exactly, so the local rows are accurate where checked, but completeness is unproven.
rows.status: Unverified: count and section claims not reproduced; full recapture pending (owner decision on population, see F-20).

rows.area: Roster events and starter announcements cited by the brief (VR-/VQ- references)
rows.item: The brief cites VR-04 to VR-08, VR-12, VR-17, VR-21, VR-23 to VR-26 and VQ-05 to VQ-08 for the Colts receiver trades, the Ravens depth rows (Lamar Jackson, Tyler Huntley), the Lock/McCord/Brissett starter changes, Malik Willis on injured reserve, and the Seattle and Washington depth slots. None of these identifiers appears anywhere in this repository (grep of all files, 2026-11-16).
rows.why: The referenced evidence is not in the repo and was not located in the official sources available here, so none of these items are verified, and no depth, starter or reserve value is published from them. Each needs its official transaction, depth-chart or report URL supplied and recorded in the sources register before it can be used.
rows.source: S31 (checked for the cited events; identifiers not found in that page)
rows.status: Unverified: cited identifiers not found; no values published.

rows.item: Daily or multi-day official captures are not built
rows.why: NFL.com Terms Section 1.3 prohibits systematic retrieval without express prior written consent. Hand transcription of the full report repeats an error class already found. A decision is needed before any capture job.
